Los Angeles|California.notes: Largest county jail system in the US. Multiple facilities.

Cook|Illinois.notes: One of the largest single-site county jails in the US. Capacity ~7,500.

Harris|Texas.notes: Harris County Jail — downtown Houston facility.

Maricopa|Arizona.notes: MCSO operates multiple jail facilities throughout the county.

San Diego|California.notes: Multiple detention facilities. Central Jail is the main booking facility.

Dallas|Texas.notes: Lew Sterrett Justice Center is the main Dallas County jail complex.

Orange|California.jail_address: 550 N Flower St, Santa Ana, CA 92703
Orange|California.notes: Theo Lacy Facility and Central Men's Jail are the main facilities.

Kings|New York.notes: Kings County (Brooklyn) inmates held by NYC DOC — primarily Rikers Island.

Miami-Dade|Florida.notes: Miami-Dade has multiple correctional facilities operated by MDC Corrections.

Riverside|California.notes: Robert Presley Detention Center is the main Riverside County jail.

Clark|Nevada.jail_address: 330 S Casino Center Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89101
Clark|Nevada.notes: Downtown Las Vegas detention facility. LVMPD also operates the Las Vegas City Jail.

Tarrant|Texas.jail_address: 100 N Lamar St, Fort Worth, TX 76196
Tarrant|Texas.notes: Fort Worth / Tarrant County main detention facility.

San Bernardino|California.notes: West Valley Detention Center is the main SB County facility.

King|Washington.sheriff_name: King County Department of Adult and Juvenile Detention
King|Washington.notes: Downtown Seattle facility. Also operates the Maleng Regional Justice Center in Kent.

Bexar|Texas.jail_address: 200 N Comal St, San Antonio, TX 78207
Bexar|Texas.notes: San Antonio area. jailinfo.bexar.org is the official inmate lookup portal.

Broward|Florida.notes: BSO (Broward Sheriff's Office) operates the Main Jail and North Broward Bureau.

Wayne|Michigan.notes: Downtown Detroit facility. Wayne County Jail and Consolidated Jail.

Alameda|California.notes: Santa Rita Jail in Dublin is the main Alameda County detention facility.

Middlesex|Massachusetts.jail_name: Middlesex County Jail & House of Correction
Middlesex|Massachusetts.notes: Cambridge facility serves the greater Boston / Cambridge area.

Philadelphia|Pennsylvania.notes: Philadelphia operates its own prison system (not county sheriff). CFCF is the main intake facility.

Sacramento|California.notes: The Sacramento County Sheriff's Office manages several detention facilities, with the Main Jail primarily handling bookings and shorter-term detention in downtown Sacramento. The Rio Cosumnes Correctional Center (RCCC) houses longer-term inmates and various programs.

Suffolk|New York.notes: The Suffolk County Sheriff's Office operates two correctional facilities, with the Riverhead location serving as the primary intake and main detention facility for the county.

Queens|New York.sheriff_name: New York City Department of Correction
Queens|New York.notes: Queens County is one of the five boroughs of New York City. The city operates a unified correctional system via the NYC Department of Correction (NYC DOC), with primary detention facilities located on Rikers Island, serving all boroughs. There is no traditional 'county sheriff' for jail administration; the NYC Sheriff's Office handles civil matters.

New York|New York.sheriff_name: New York City Department of Correction
New York|New York.notes: Jail operations for New York County (Manhattan) are managed by the New York City Department of Correction, not a traditional county sheriff's office. The Manhattan Detention Complex is one of several facilities within the NYC DOC system, which also includes Rikers Island.

Bronx|New York.sheriff_name: New York City Department of Correction
Bronx|New York.notes: Bronx County's detention facilities are operated by the New York City Department of Correction, not a traditional county sheriff. The Vernon C. Bain Center (The Barge) is a prominent facility located within the Bronx borough, though major intake and other facilities for New York City are also on Rikers Island.

Mecklenburg|North Carolina.notes: The Mecklenburg County Detention Center serves as the primary jail facility, managed by the Sheriff's Office. It operates multiple sites, all searchable through a unified online inmate roster.

Travis|Texas.jail_address: 3614 Bill Price Rd, Del Valle, TX 78724
Travis|Texas.notes: The Travis County Sheriff's Office operates the Travis County Correctional Complex (TCCC) as its main detention facility, housing pre-trial detainees and sentenced inmates. Located southeast of Austin, TCCC is one of the largest county jails in Texas.

Collin|Texas.notes: The Collin County Detention Facility operates under the Collin County Sheriff's Office and is a large county jail providing detention services for individuals awaiting trial or serving short sentences in north Texas.

Hillsborough|Florida.notes: Hillsborough County operates multiple detention facilities under the Sheriff's Office, with the Falkenburg Road Jail serving as the primary adult detention center. Inmates are held here awaiting trial or serving county-level sentences.

Oakland|Michigan.sheriff_name: Oakland County Sheriff Michael J. Bouchard
Oakland|Michigan.jail_address: 1200 N. Telegraph Rd., Bldg. 38E, Pontiac, MI 48341
Oakland|Michigan.notes: The Oakland County Sheriff's Office does not maintain its own online inmate roster, directing the public to use the VINELink system or contact the facility by phone for inmate information.

Orange|Florida.notes: The Orange County Jail is operated by the Orange County Sheriff's Office Corrections Department and serves as the primary detention facility for Orange County, Florida, processing a large number of bookings annually.

Nassau|New York.notes: The Nassau County Correctional Facility is the primary detention facility for the county and is managed by the Nassau County Sheriff's Department.

Shelby|Tennessee.notes: The Shelby County Division of Corrections is a large county correctional system, operating the main detention center at 201 Poplar Ave. It is one of the largest county jail facilities in Tennessee, managing an average daily population of over 2,000 inmates.

Franklin|Ohio.notes: The Franklin County Corrections Center is the main adult detention facility for Franklin County, Ohio, overseen by the Franklin County Sheriff's Office. It is located in downtown Columbus.

Hennepin|Minnesota.notes: The Hennepin County Adult Detention Center is located in downtown Minneapolis and is one of Minnesota's largest county jails, processing a high volume of inmates for the region.

Contra Costa|California.sheriff_name: Contra Costa County Office of the Sheriff
Contra Costa|California.notes: The Contra Costa County Office of the Sheriff operates multiple detention facilities, with the Martinez Detention Facility being one of the primary sites. The 'Who's In Jail' search provides information for all individuals housed in county facilities.

Wake|North Carolina.sheriff_name: Wake County Sheriff's Office - Sheriff Willie Rowe
Wake|North Carolina.notes: The Wake County Detention Center is a large facility located in Raleigh, serving as the primary holding facility for all arrests made within Wake County. It offers an online inmate search portal for public access to inmate information.

El Paso|Texas.notes: The El Paso County Detention Facility is operated by the Sheriff's Office and serves as the primary county jail, housing pre-trial detainees and inmates serving misdemeanor sentences.

Pima|Arizona.notes: The Pima County Adult Detention Complex is the main county jail, managed by the Pima County Sheriff's Department. It serves as the primary intake and housing facility for individuals awaiting trial or serving sentences for misdemeanor and felony offenses.

Cuyahoga|Ohio.notes: The Cuyahoga County Jail is the primary detention facility for Cuyahoga County, managed by the Sheriff's Department. It is a large urban jail located within the Justice Center complex in downtown Cleveland.

Pinellas|Florida.notes: The Pinellas County Sheriff's Office operates the Pinellas County Jail, which serves as the primary detention facility for Pinellas County, Florida.

Jefferson|Alabama.jail_address: 809 Richard Arrington Jr. Blvd N, Birmingham, AL 35203
Jefferson|Alabama.notes: The Jefferson County Sheriff's Office operates two main jail facilities, one in Birmingham and one in Bessemer. The inmate roster provided on their website covers individuals housed at both locations.

Palm Beach|Florida.jail_name: Palm Beach County Main Detention Center
Palm Beach|Florida.jail_address: 3228 Gun Club Rd, West Palm Beach, FL 33406
Palm Beach|Florida.notes: The Palm Beach County Sheriff's Office operates the Main Detention Center and several other facilities, managing an average daily inmate population of approximately 2,000. They provide various services including inmate programs and visitation.

Denver|Colorado.notes: The City and County of Denver is a consolidated municipality. The Denver Sheriff Department is responsible for operating the county's detention facilities, including the Downtown Detention Center.

Hamilton|Ohio.notes: The Hamilton County Justice Center is the primary detention facility, managed by the Hamilton County Sheriff's Office. It also houses courtrooms and other criminal justice functions within the same complex.

Salt Lake|Utah.jail_address: 3415 S 900 W, South Salt Lake, UT 84119
Salt Lake|Utah.notes: The Salt Lake County Metro Jail is the primary detention facility for Salt Lake County, managed by the Salt Lake County Sheriff's Office, and is the largest jail in Utah.

Montgomery|Maryland.notes: Montgomery County's detention facilities are managed by the Department of Correction and Rehabilitation. The Montgomery County Detention Center primarily holds pre-trial detainees and inmates serving shorter sentences.

Prince George's|Maryland.jail_address: 13400 Duley Station Rd, Upper Marlboro, MD 20772
Prince George's|Maryland.notes: The Prince George's County Department of Corrections operates the Detention Center. The county does not provide a direct online inmate roster and directs inquiries to phone calls or the Maryland VINE system.

Essex|New Jersey.notes: The Essex County Correctional Facility is one of New Jersey's largest county jails, known for housing a significant number of inmates and also operating under an agreement with ICE for federal detainees.

Hudson|New Jersey.notes: The Hudson County Correctional Facility also houses federal ICE detainees. Public inmate information for New Jersey county jails is primarily available via the statewide VINElink system, as the county does not maintain its own online roster.

Fulton|Georgia.notes: The Fulton County Jail is one of the largest detention facilities in Georgia and has faced ongoing challenges with overcrowding, dilapidated conditions, and inmate care, leading to significant legal and public scrutiny.

DeKalb|Georgia.notes: The DeKalb County Jail is operated by the DeKalb County Sheriff's Office and is the primary detention facility for DeKalb County, one of Georgia's most populous counties.

Gwinnett|Georgia.notes: The Gwinnett County Detention Center is a major facility within one of Georgia's most populous counties, handling pre-trial detainees and inmates serving misdemeanor sentences.

Duval|Florida.notes: The Jacksonville Sheriff's Office operates the Duval County Pretrial Detention Facility, which serves as the primary intake and detention center for Duval County. Due to the consolidated government, the Sheriff's Office handles law enforcement for both the City of Jacksonville and Duval County.

Multnomah|Oregon.notes: Multnomah County operates two primary adult detention facilities, the Multnomah County Detention Center (MCDC) and the Inverness Jail (IJ). The provided information primarily pertains to MCDC, which is located in downtown Portland.

Ada|Idaho.notes: The Ada County Jail serves as the primary detention facility for the most populous county in Idaho, located in the Boise metropolitan area. It is managed by the Ada County Sheriff's Office.

Milwaukee|Wisconsin.notes: The Milwaukee County Jail is a direct supervision facility located within the Public Safety Building in downtown Milwaukee and is overseen by the Milwaukee County Sheriff's Office. It primarily holds pre-trial detainees and individuals serving short sentences.

Erie|New York.notes: Erie County's primary detention facility is the Holding Center, located in downtown Buffalo, which serves as the intake and pre-trial detention site, while a separate Correctional Facility houses sentenced inmates.

Westchester|New York.notes: The Westchester County Department of Correction does not offer an online inmate search roster. Inmate information must be obtained by calling the facility directly.

Hartford|Connecticut.notes: Connecticut abolished county sheriffs as jail operators in 2000. All correctional facilities, including the Hartford Correctional Center, are operated by the Connecticut Department of Correction, a state agency.

New Haven|Connecticut.notes: Connecticut abolished county sheriffs in 2000, and all correctional facilities, including this one, are operated by the state's Department of Correction. This facility serves as a major intake and detention center for the New Haven area.

Fairfield|Connecticut.notes: Connecticut operates a statewide correctional system, and traditional county sheriffs do not manage jails. The Bridgeport Correctional Center, run by the Connecticut Department of Correction, serves Fairfield County for pre-trial detention and sentences.

Dane|Wisconsin.notes: The Dane County Sheriff's Office does not provide an online inmate search or roster; inquiries must be made by phone. The jail system includes multiple facilities, with the Public Safety Building serving as a primary intake location.

Bernalillo|New Mexico.jail_address: 10000 Law Enforcement Rd SW, Albuquerque, NM 87121
Bernalillo|New Mexico.notes: The Metropolitan Detention Center (MDC) is Bernalillo County's primary detention facility and the largest jail in New Mexico, housing both pre-trial detainees and sentenced offenders.

Pinal|Arizona.jail_address: 971 N. Jason Lopez Parkway, Florence, AZ 85132
Pinal|Arizona.notes: The Pinal County Adult Detention Center is the main county jail, overseen by the Pinal County Sheriff's Office. It provides an online inmate search and details on inmate services and visitation.

Snohomish|Washington.notes: The Snohomish County Jail is operated by the Corrections Bureau within the Sheriff's Office and serves as the primary detention facility for the county, providing incarceration and various inmate programs.

Pierce|Washington.notes: The Pierce County Jail is a large detention facility housing pre-trial and sentenced inmates. Public inmate information is primarily provided through VineLink.

Spokane|Washington.notes: Spokane County Detention Services manages the main county jail. For inmate information and search, the county officially directs users to the statewide VINElink system.

Jefferson|Colorado.notes: The Jefferson County Detention Facility is operated by the Sheriff's Office and is the primary correctional facility for the county, providing detention and rehabilitative services for inmates.

Arapahoe|Colorado.notes: The Arapahoe County Detention Facility is the main jail operated by the Sheriff's Office, providing detention services for individuals awaiting trial or serving short sentences in Arapahoe County, which is part of the 18th Judicial District.
